pricing_document.note: No live provider tariff has been established by a primary source or operator attestation (docs/phase0/DOC_EVIDENCE.md). Every row therefore has unit_price null with an unknown_reason. A candidate OpenAI figure appears in DOC_EVIDENCE as an unverified documentation excerpt and is deliberately NOT entered here. Operators add attested rows with effective dates and evidence ids; nothing is ever defaulted to zero.

cost.statement: Amounts group non-superseded lines by currency and provenance. A known subtotal is not a total cost unless completeness is complete; zero in a provenance bucket means no recorded charge of that provenance, not free.

Run manifest (evidence.bundle). The identity, integrity and artifact fields
are closed and required; nested policy/provider sections are typed as objects.
Sections added by later phases (signing, restricted exports) must be added here
deliberately: unknown top-level keys are rejected.
